blocks.text: Setting up Gmail for event coordinators on Mac

Since there is no native Gmail app for macOS, you should create a dedicated web app. Open Gmail in Chrome, click the three-dot menu, select Save and Share, then select Install page as app. This keeps your inbox separate from your browsing. In Safari, go to File then Add to Dock to achieve the same result on macOS Sonoma.

Speed is vital when you manage hundreds of emails a day. Go to Settings, then General, then Keyboard shortcuts to turn them on. Once active, press ? to see the full list. Use c to compose, e to archive, and r to reply. If you get stuck, ask Lazur to explain what a specific key combination does.

items: Create labels for each event or vendor category.
Use filters to automatically move emails from specific domains into these labels.

Archive messages immediately after you complete the required action.

blocks.text: Event coordinators often deal with repetitive inquiries. Create templates in Settings under Advanced to save time. When you need to find a specific setting, hold ⌥ ⌘ and ask Lazur to point it out.

You might reach your daily sending limit if you email large attendee lists. Keep track of your recipient count. If you hit a limit, you may be blocked for 24 hours. Use BCC for mass communications to protect attendee privacy.
Using Lazur in your Gmail workflow

Lazur helps you maintain focus while you work on your Mac. When you need to draft a complex email, hold fn and dictate your thoughts. Lazur ensures the text is formatted correctly. If you are unsure about a setting, hold ⌥ ⌘ and ask a question. Lazur will answer out loud without you needing to leave your inbox.

If you see a 502 error, refresh your browser. Check your internet connection if you see an Oops message. If an email fails to send, check your attachments. Large files can cause issues. Use Google Drive links instead of direct attachments when possible.

faq.question: Is there an official Gmail app for Mac?
faq.answer: No, Google does not provide a native desktop app for macOS. You can create a web app using Chrome or Safari.

faq.question: How do I turn on keyboard shortcuts?
faq.answer: Go to Gmail Settings, then the General tab, and scroll down to Keyboard shortcuts to enable them.

faq.question: Can Lazur click buttons in Gmail for me?
faq.answer: No, Lazur does not click buttons. It points at them on your screen or guides you through the steps to do it yourself.

faq.question: What happens if I exceed my daily email limit?
faq.answer: You may be blocked from sending emails for 24 hours. This applies to the total number of recipients across all your messages.
